dct_description_sm: These data represent observations from an inventory of woody plants, September 2023 to January 2024.  Plot locations were created on a 50 x 50-m systematic grid; each location in forest cover was sampled using circular plots.  In each plot, the tally of each tree species (in a 3-m radius plot) as well as percent cover of the woody portion of each shrub species (in a 1-m radius plot) were recorded.

Abundance of forest woody plant species (density of trees, density and percent cover of shrubs) and ancillary information (geographic coordinates, community type) derived from systematic plots in Ashburnham Memorial Park, Peterborough, Ontario, Canada, 2023-2024.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Inventory of Woody Plants in Ashburnham Memorial Park, 2024
